stories.title: Amerikaanse Huis van Afgevaardigden VS keurt sanctiepakket tegen Rusland goed

en.title: US House of Representatives approves sanctions package against Russia
en.summary: The US House of Representatives has approved a comprehensive sanctions package targeting Russia, intended to restrict Russian financial flows supporting the war in Ukraine.

stories.title: Ook Amerikaans lagerhuis stemt in met omvangrijk sanctiepakket tegen Rusland

en.title: US House of Representatives approves comprehensive sanctions package against Russia
en.summary: The US House of Representatives approved a major sanctions package against Russia designed to limit Russian funding for the Ukraine war. The Senate had previously agreed to the measure, and it now awaits President Trump's signature.

stories.title: Italiaanse regering schrapt wegenbelasting deels vanwege hoge brandstofprijzen

en.title: Italian government partially eliminates road tax due to high fuel prices
en.summary: Italy's government will eliminate road tax for many vehicles in 2027 as a response to fuel price concerns. The government has not yet clarified how it will address the resulting 2 billion euro budget shortfall.

stories.title: Al jaren voortvluchtige Oussama B., die hielp bij voorbereiden moord advocaat Derk Wiersum, opgepakt in Parijs

en.title: Long-fugitive Oussama B., who helped prepare murder of lawyer Derk Wiersum, arrested in Paris
en.summary: A man wanted for years in connection with preparing the murder of Dutch lawyer Derk Wiersum has been arrested in Paris. He allegedly helped coordinate surveillance of the lawyer's home and office, and arranged vehicles for the shooters.

stories.title: AZ start Europa League-seizoen met nederlaag bij Sunderland en uitblinker Roefs

en.title: AZ starts Europa League season with defeat at Sunderland and standout Roefs
en.summary: AZ Alkmaar began their Europa League campaign with a 1-0 loss to Sunderland. Goalkeeper Robin Roefs made several important saves in an otherwise unsuccessful performance.

stories.title: Fed verhoogt Amerikaanse rente voor het eerst in drie jaar, tegen de wil van Trump in

en.title: Fed raises US interest rate for first time in three years, against Trump's wishes
en.summary: The US Federal Reserve has increased interest rates for the first time in three years, a decision contrary to the preferences expressed by Trump.

stories.title: Italiaanse regering schrapt wegenbelasting in aanloop naar verkiezingen

en.title: Italian government eliminates road tax ahead of elections
en.summary: Italy's government is removing road tax for next year, framing it as compensation for high fuel prices. Critics view it as an electoral tactic, though Prime Minister Meloni states the abolition is intended to be permanent.

stories.title: Tot frustratie van Trump verhoogt centrale bank voor het eerst in drie jaar de rente

en.title: To Trump's frustration, central bank raises interest rates for first time in three years
en.summary: The U.S. Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate to combat inflation, marking the first increase in over three years. President Trump expressed displeasure with the decision, having hoped the new Fed chair would lower rates instead.

stories.title: Amerikaanse bank verhoogt rente tegen wens Trump in voor het eerst in drie jaar

en.title: American bank raises interest rates against Trump's wishes for the first time in three years
en.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh increased the interest rate to 3.75-4 percent on Wednesday, acting contrary to President Trump's preferences in what represents the first rate hike under his leadership.

stories.title: Voortvluchtige Oussama B. gepakt in Parijs, hielp bij voorbereiden moord Derk Wiersum

en.title: Fugitive Oussama B. arrested in Paris, helped prepare murder of Derk Wiersum
en.summary: Oussama B., wanted in connection with preparations for the murder of lawyer Derk Wiersum, has been arrested in Paris. He was sentenced to over eleven years in prison on appeal in September.

stories.title: Oussama B. na jaren opgepakt voor voorbereiding moord Wiersum

en.title: Oussama B. arrested after years for preparation of Wiersum murder
en.summary: Oussama B. was arrested Wednesday in Paris after years on the run. He received an over eleven-year prison sentence on appeal for his involvement in the murder of lawyer Derk Wiersum.

stories.title: Belarus laat 25 politieke gevangenen vrij na afspraak met de VS, maar gaat door met het arresteren van andere critici

en.title: Belarus releases 25 political prisoners following agreement with U.S., but continues arresting other critics
en.summary: Belarus freed 25 political prisoners as part of an agreement with the United States. The country has continued detaining other individuals critical of its government.
